up: Show the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1741324. Return the ChEMBL ID of the compound, the standard activity type, the standard relation, the standard value, and the standard units.
sql: SELECT activities.molregno, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741324' ORDER BY activities.activity_id;
